guarantees.claim: prim_buf instance u_prim_buf_mul_am0 continuously drives the four output signals with the values of the corresponding input signals, bit-for-bit, as a 16-bit wide buffer.
prim_buf instance u_prim_buf_mul_am1 continuously drives the four output signals with the values of the corresponding input signals, bit-for-bit, as a 16-bit wide buffer.

assumptions.claim: The eight 4-bit input signals (mul_a0_b_inv, mul_a0_t, mul_m0_b_inv, mul_m0_t, mul_a1_b_inv, mul_a1_t, mul_m1_b_inv, mul_m1_t) are driven by valid, stable logic values before being used by the prim_buf instances.
assumptions.risk: Glitches or contention on these inputs could propagate through the buffers and create side-channel leakage or functional corruption of the masked S-box shares.

uncertain_points.claim: Arrays a1_inv, a1_inv_buf, a0_inv, a0_inv_buf (each depth 4) are declared but never assigned or used within this region; they may be intended for a later pipelining step and risk remaining undriven or becoming dead logic.
uncertain_points.cond: depends on assignment elsewhere in the module (or unused)
uncertain_points.risk: If not driven, these wires will be high-impedance or X, potentially causing functional failure in subsequent masked inverse logic or synthesis/simulation mismatches.
